note: Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 4 states that what is contained in the word of God and proposed by the Church, by solemn judgment or ordinary and universal magisterium, as divinely revealed is to be believed with divine and catholic faith, that is on the authority of God revealing (para. 1). The premise states that whatever a society assisted by g definitively proposes as revealed, g confirms. The council gives a normative rule fixing the object of faith; it does not speak of assistance or say that God confirms each proposal.
